summary: Bridgewater Bancshares Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results via press release and earnings presentation (Items 2.02, 7.01, and 9.01). Additionally, under Item 8.01, it announced a regular quarterly cash dividend on its 5.875% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series A: $36.72 per share ($0.3672 per depositary share), payable June 1, 2026 to holders of record May 15, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration filing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is described.
